f.title: Scope: all holders of registrations of human medicines distributed or marketed in Brazil

f.title: Definition: adverse events covered (eight classes)
f.statement: Adverse effects or other medicine-related problems (referred to in the Art. 2 definition of pharmacovigilance) are called adverse events (AE) and are classified as: I suspected adverse drug reactions; II AEs from medicine quality deviations; III AEs from unapproved use; IV drug interactions; V total or partial therapeutic ineffectiveness; VI medicine-related intoxications; VII medicine abuse; VIII potential and actual medication errors.
f.clause: Chapter 1 General provisions, Art. 2 §1 and §2

f.title: Handle quality deviations posing health risk under the quality-deviation legislation

rows.quote: § 3º Caso existam indícios suficientes ou comprovação de desvio de qualidade querepresentem risco, agravo ou conseqüência danosa à saúde, os detentores de registro demedicamentos devem proceder de acordo com a legislação vigente para o desvio daqualidade de medicamentos.
